lines.text: Jesus warns against doing righteous acts to be seen, and says hypocrites sound a trumpet when they give to the needy.
Jesus says not to let your left hand know what your right hand is doing, so giving stays in secret.
Jesus says the hypocrites pray in the temple courts, but you should go into your inner room and shut your door.

wrong_details.true: the synagogues and on the street corners

lines.text: Jesus teaches a prayer that begins with Our Father in heaven and asks God to deliver us from our enemies.
Jesus says when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face, so only your Father who is unseen knows.
